generatedWith: PixelLab ProFlash, PixMiniMax, explicit skeleton v3, outfit transfer and deterministic PixelLab workbench cleanup
coordinateConvention: PNG top-left origin; integer pixel pivots; bottom exclusive. Unity normalized pivot=(x/width,1-y/height). Clip pivot overrides actor pivot.

Run.playbackNote: Source frames are poses; 20 fps retains the existing approved 400 ms run cycle. Do not apply another 1.5x multiplier. All frames share pivot y=40; two airborne poses end at y=38.

motionPolicy: Art metadata describes poses only. Existing runtime owns world translation, invulnerability, damage and stun timing. Attack contactFrame=5 is visually aligned to runtime attack contact at 0.2 seconds; do not retime gameplay to raw fps.
controlPolicy: DodgeDown is sword parry. DodgeForward art is delivered but control binding remains disabled until the user decides.
runtimeValidation: Art files reviewed and audited. Unity import/playmode QA is owned by the integration session and is not claimed complete here.

excluded.firstRunReason: Torso stood upright during cycle, fails forward lean requirement.
excluded.firstHitReason: Unrequested bright VFX in frames. Runtime owns flash/VFX.
excluded.rawSkeletonRunReason: Weapon continuity inadequate; replaced by outfit-transfer result while keeping its skeleton motion.
